part.name: Rounded-end bar with blended hollow boss (blind bore)
part.description: Single solid part consisting of a long rectangular bar with one rounded planform end, and a hollow cylindrical boss mounted on one face via a smooth blend. The boss contains a blind cylindrical bore (open at top, closed at bottom).
part.symmetry_note: Model appears symmetric about the mid-plane of the bar thickness (approx. plane z=4 in STEP bbox), with boss and rounded end centered on that plane.

Section.name: Main bar (prismatic body)
features included: Square end face (termination at one end)
Section.function intent: Provide a stiff lever/strap-like body to carry and transmit loads to/from the boss and to interface with other structures along its flat faces.
Section.physical behavior: Acts predominantly in bending and torsion as a long beam; planar faces provide stable contact and distribute bearing loads; end face acts as a hard stop/trim boundary.
Section.geometry: Long rectangular prism/plate with constant cross-section over most of its length; one end is square (planar end face), the other transitions to a rounded end handled in a separate section. Faces are primarily planar with sharp edges except where intersecting blend/rounded-end topology creates additional edges.
Section.location: Dominant body spanning the full length; excludes the rounded end surface and the boss/blend region surfaces.

major_faces.name: Bar broad face A
major_faces.description: Large planar face of the bar (one of the two opposite broad faces), bounded by rounded end and boss cut/blend edges.

major_faces.name: Bar side face (low-Y side)
major_faces.description: Long planar side face at the minimum Y extent of the bar, running full length including into the rounded end boundary.

major_faces.name: Bar broad face B
major_faces.description: Opposite large planar face of the bar (parallel to face 0000).

major_faces.name: Bar side face (high-Y main run)
major_faces.description: Long planar side face at the maximum Y extent of the bar, present over the straight run away from boss/rounded-end interruptions.

major_faces.name: Square end face
major_faces.description: Planar termination face at the square end of the bar (max-X end).

Section.name: Rounded bar end (planform radius end)
features included: Rounded/contoured end for clearance and reduced stress concentration
Local planar patch at the side boundary near the rounded transition
Section.function intent: Provide a smooth end geometry for clearance, safer handling, and reduced stress concentration versus a sharp corner/end.
Section.physical behavior: Reduces peak stress at the end and improves load flow in bending by removing sharp geometric discontinuities.
Section.geometry: Cylindrical side surface forming the rounded end profile (extruded through thickness), plus a small planar patch at the adjacent side boundary created by topology where the rounded end meets the straight side and nearby features.
Section.location: At the non-square end of the bar (the rounded end, near min-X of the STEP bbox).

major_faces.name: Rounded end cylindrical side
major_faces.description: Cylindrical surface forming the rounded end boundary of the bar (radius per STEP: 17.5).

major_faces.name: Small side planar patch near rounded end
major_faces.description: Small planar face segment at the bar side boundary near the rounded end, created by local edge partitioning.

Section.name: Boss-to-bar blend (saddle/fillet transition)
features included: Stress-relief and load-path smoothing at boss root
Section.function intent: Provide a smooth, robust root transition between the boss and the bar to lower stress concentration and improve manufacturability/strength.
Section.physical behavior: Transfers load from boss into bar through a gradually changing curvature, reducing notch effects and improving fatigue resistance.
Section.geometry: Single BSpline (freeform) surface wrapping around the boss root, blending from the bar planar faces into the boss cylindrical surface.
Section.location: At the base of the boss where it meets the bar (near the boss centerline, around x≈0 region in STEP).

major_faces.name: Root blend surface
major_faces.description: BSpline blend/fillet surface connecting the boss outer cylinder to the bar faces around the boss footprint.

Section.name: Outer boss (sleeve body and top rim)
features included: Top annular interface face (rim around bore opening)
Section.function intent: Provide a raised locating/interface sleeve for a mating cylindrical component (pin/shaft/fastener) and to stiffen the local region around the bore.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as a short cylindrical shell in compression/bearing; outer wall provides hoop stiffness and resists side loads transferred through the bore into the bar.
Section.geometry: Outer cylindrical surface (radius per STEP: 7) plus the top annular planar face (outer rim) with a central opening.
Section.location: Mounted on the bar near one end (around the boss centerline at x≈0, above the bar via the blend).

major_faces.name: Boss outer cylindrical wall
major_faces.description: Outer cylindrical surface of the boss (radius 7) extending from blend region to the top rim.

major_faces.name: Boss top annular face
major_faces.description: Top planar annulus (outer radius 7, inner radius 5) surrounding the bore opening.

Section.name: Blind bore (internal hole feature)
Section.function intent: Provide a guided cylindrical seat for a mating pin/shaft/fastener with a defined insertion depth (blind end).
Section.physical behavior: Inner cylindrical wall provides radial constraint and bearing contact; bottom face provides axial stop to constrain insertion depth and axial DOF.
Section.geometry: Inner cylindrical surface (radius per STEP: 5) open at the boss top, terminating at a flat circular bottom face.
Section.location: Concentric within the boss, opening at the boss top face and stopping at an internal plane.

major_faces.name: Bore cylindrical wall
major_faces.description: Inner cylindrical surface of the blind bore (radius 5), coaxial with boss axis.

major_faces.name: Bore bottom face
major_faces.description: Planar circular face closing the blind bore at its bottom (area ≈ π·5^2).
